correctness.rationale: Universal VC upper bound is reduced by XOR translation to all 7,260 incidence multisets of five weight-at-most-two queries. Both independent exhaustive verifiers yield at most 26 of 31 nonzero patterns, so no five-query shattering. Four-query witnesses give the lower bound. Universal online upper bound uses the radius-two center fiber F and classified H1/H2 positive branches, with exceptional negative families reducible to fixed-stars or singletons; hence Ldim≤5 in every dimension. A fully replayed depth-five tree with 31 internal queries and 32 distinct leaf witnesses proves Ldim≥5 in dimension six and above. Exact small dimensions are proved by counting/branch splits and checked with a full recurrence. No finite experiment is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The natural closed radius-two cube range space is used in fixed-radius neighborhoods, coding-inspired learning and model-theoretic shattering. The new all-dimension classification identifies a sharp first and persistent one-bit gap at ambient dimension six while keeping both dimensions bounded. The coordinate-incidence obstruction and the star-restricted adaptive proof provide specific structural explanations beyond enumeration or routine bounding.
